rationale.intuition: CMU SCS (School of Computer Science) is the single most competitive intl CS admission in the US — overall CMU 11.66% but SCS direct admit ~6-8%; intl SCS estimated 2-4%. 国际部 (Chinese international division) AP-heavy profile is the largest CMU CS bucket and most saturated. USACO Gold (not Platinum) is below the typical CMU SCS admitted-student bar. RD has no early boost. Industry: CMU SCS intl-CN 国际部 strong cluster 1.5-7% per Crimson + CollegeVine data.

sources.name: CMU CDS 2024-25 + SCS Admit Bulletin
sources.evidence: Overall admit 11.66%; ED 13.84%. SCS direct-admit is materially lower (~6-8% per CMU internal disclosure); intl SCS pool dominated by 国际部 CN applicants.

sources.name: Crimson China CS Benchmark 2024 — CMU SCS
sources.evidence: 国际部 AP-heavy applicants at CMU SCS RD with USACO Gold cluster 2-7% per published case data; USACO Platinum + research publication needed for >10% odds.

sources.name: CollegeVine CMU SCS Profile Database 2024
sources.evidence: Admitted intl CS profiles cluster at SAT 1560+, USACO Platinum, multi-year published research; profiles below this bar cluster at 1-5% admit.
